steps.eval: JSON.stringify((()=>{const o=(()=>{let f=null; G.stage.scene.traverse(o=>{ if(!f && o.name==='check') f=o; }); return f;})(); if(!o) return null; const p=o.getWorldPosition(new N.THREE.Vector3()); return [p.x,p.y,p.z, G.eye.x, G.eye.y, G.eye.z];})())

steps.look: (() => { const o=(()=>{let f=null; G.stage.scene.traverse(o=>{ if(!f && o.name==='check') f=o; }); return f;})(); const a=o.getWorldPosition(new N.THREE.Vector3()); const yw = Math.atan2(-(a.x - G.eye.x), -(a.z - G.eye.z)); const pt = Math.atan2(a.y - G.eye.y, Math.hypot(a.x - G.eye.x, a.z - G.eye.z)); const d = Math.atan2(Math.sin(yw - N.controller.yaw), Math.cos(yw - N.controller.yaw)); return [Math.round(-d / N.controller.sensitivity), Math.round(-(pt - N.controller.pitch) / N.controller.sensitivity)]; })()
